task_title: Align quest arrows for objectives in the same room

plan_review.notes: Reviewer flagged one blocking semantic leak: sharing dirX/dirY for angle also silently shared off-screen culling and displayed distance. Fixed by keeping culling+distance derived from the precise x/y target and only the angle from dirX/dirY; added a regression test asserting an off-screen precise target with an on-screen shared anchor still renders correctly. Reviewer also raised non-blocking design musings (doorway/roomId=-1 targets, moving-NPC room instability, very large/disjoint rooms, an alternate roomId+angle-only API shape); current behavior already skips grouping when getRoomAt returns -1 (no regression) and the rest are pre-existing room-graph/anchor-picker properties out of scope for this surgical arrow-direction fix, so they are not counted as plan concerns requiring resolution.

rounds.notes: Round 1: reviewer flagged the ledger itself as incomplete (this process step, now completed) and an unrelated pre-existing naming inconsistency in MainGameScene.ts not part of this PR diff (confirmed via git diff origin/main..HEAD).

Round 2: reviewer surfaced MainGameScene.ts quartermasterOpen naming and companionKOSystem.ts per-frame Set allocation x2; all three confirmed via `git diff origin/main..HEAD --stat` to be pre-existing code untouched by this PR (only questWaypoints.ts, HudDirectionArrows.ts, and their tests changed), so not counted as concerns against this diff. No actionable findings within this PR's own diff.

independent_grade.notes: The change perfectly implements the shared room anchor for quest arrows by separating precise (x/y) coordinates from direction (dirX/dirY) coordinates. It updates the HUD to use precise coordinates for culling and distance while relying on the shared direction to unify rotations. Coverage is excellent, spanning unit, e2e, and system tests, and the code remains highly disciplined, readable, and compliant with repository policies.
